status.description: done = you committed the work this brief asked for and journalled it; no_work = nothing in your write-scope needed doing (say why); blocked = you could not finish (say what stopped you); refuted = a [YOURS] finding is WRONG and you have the evidence (quote it). A [YOURS] finding that is already satisfied at HEAD is no_work with the evidence, not refuted: refuted disputes the finding, no_work says the work is done.

message.description: One paragraph for the NEXT invocation of your role: what you did, what the gate said, what is left. Evidence, not assurance — a command and its output beat a sentence.

refuted_ids.description: Finding ids (or the finding's first words) you refuted, with status refuted.
